caption: The drawing features a single object centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The object is an ornate, golden-colored gauntlet shaped as a hand, shown in profile, with detailed decorations on the wrist and cuff area. The fingers of the hand are slightly curled and are holding three yellowish-gold flowers with green stems and leaves. The gauntlet has engraved patterns and a central oval design on the wrist section. Faint pencil marks, including the handwritten name "Harry Jennings," are present below the illustration, and there are small crosshairs and light pencil marks on the outer edges of the page.
title: Tie-back
